author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Yishmael’s student. He speaks in Rabbi Yishmael’s name in Berakhot 48b and in the Mekhilta, Bo, parashah 16:3.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Berakhot 48b paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Chiyya bar Nachmani as Rabbi Yishmael’s student speaking in his name. The whole Beeri 2019 Mekhilta, Tractate Pischa 16, paragraph 22 likewise names Rabbi Chiya bar Nachmani reporting Rabbi Yishmael. Hyman’s Bo 16:3 locator is retained without claiming equivalence of paragraph numbering across editions or admitting a new teacher relationship.
